title: Hangman Deluxe
story: From basic Hangman to Hangman Deluxe: word categories, ASCII hangman art that draws frame by frame, score tracking, hints that cost points, multiple rounds, and a final score summary. The complete word game experience — all in one file.
why: Hangman Deluxe combines all prior concepts: enums for categories, structs for game state, Vec for tracking, match for outcomes, and rich text output — a polished, playable game.
analogy: A TV game show with rounds, categories, and a big scoreboard. Each wrong guess draws the hangman on screen. Each correct letter fills in the puzzle. Your deluxe version has categories (like Jeopardy columns), hints that cost points, and a running total that builds drama across rounds.
try_it: Add 5+ categories with 10+ words each. Add difficulty: Easy (8 lives), Medium (6), Hard (4). Add timed mode where each round has a countdown. Implement a two-player mode: one player enters the word, the other guesses.
tips: Separate word bank from game logic — easy to add categories without touching gameplay
Draw hangman progressively: each wrong guess adds one body part
Score should reward: fewer wrong guesses, fewer hints used, longer words
common_mistakes: Not resetting guessed letters between rounds — carryover ruins the next round
Giving hints that are too revealing — 'first letter is P' makes the game trivial
Drawing hangman out of order — body parts must follow a logical progression
